summary.en: Iranian forces say they destroyed a US radar site in Bahrain in retaliation for a strike on southern Iran, and the IRGC repeats the claim of destroying the same radar. In northwest Pakistan, an assault killed ten police officers and 18 fighters, while security forces in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa killed 74 terrorists during raids and a separate attack on a Mastung post resulted in three terrorists killed and two civilians dead. The conflict still accounts for 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iranske styrker sier de ødela et amerikansk radarsystem på Bahrain som gjengjeldelse for et angrep på sørlige Iran, og IRGC gjentar påstanden om å ha ødelagt det samme radarsystemet. I nordvestlige Pakistan drepte et angrep ti politibetjenter og 18 kampere, mens sikkerhetsstyrker i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa drepte 74 terrorister under razziaer, og et separat angrep på en post i Mastung resulterte i tre terrorister drept og to sivile døde. Konflikten står fortsatt for 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
